derivation: This is C2-waiting-child-pass-order's resulting checkpoint with one change: the parent's waiting reference lists its two child obligation identifiers in the pass row's source order instead of raw UTF-8 order, with the last receipt and replay recommitted to the changed state so that no stale history commitment is the fault. The identities are the same set, so the reference still names the right pass. LIFE-019 fixes the order of child-pass obligation IDs as raw UTF-8 and states that the consumer refuses any noncanonical ordering as STATE_INVALID before applying the next event, so the checkpoint is refused before the CLOCK event is considered and the exact supplied state is returned.
